result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber coverage at USD 5M for Kubient’s data processing, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It preserves the existing general-provisions language and is professionally drafted. However, requiring every policy to remain in force for one year after the Term goes beyond the playbook and is unnecessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation coverage.
